150.example: Sustainable development aims at providing secure livelihoods for the poor.

150.english_meaning: In a way that is deliberate, intentional, or done with awareness.
150.example: We must consciously adopt eco-friendly practices to protect nature.

151.english_meaning: Economic development that is conducted without depletion of natural resources, meeting present needs without compromising future generations.
151.hindi_meaning: सतत विकास (ऐसा विकास जो भविष्य की पीढ़ियों की आवश्यकताओं से समझौता किए बिना वर्तमान की जरूरतों को पूरा करे।)
151.example: Sustainable development ensures that economic growth does not harm the environment.

151.english_meaning: The process of damaging or lowering the quality, condition, or value of something, such as the environment.
151.hindi_meaning: क्षरण, अवनति या गिरावट (पर्यावरण या भूमि की गुणवत्ता में कमी आना।)
151.example: Deforestation leads to severe environmental degradation.

151.english_meaning: To pass on or leave something, such as property, assets, or a healthy environment, to successors or future generations.
151.example: We must bequeath a clean and green planet to our children.

151.english_meaning: The protection, preservation, management, or restoration of wildlife and natural resources.
151.hindi_meaning: संरक्षण (प्राकृतिक संसाधनों की रक्षा और उनका समझदारी से उपयोग करना।)
151.example: Water conservation is essential for tackling future droughts.

151.english_meaning: Having the ability to revive, restore, or grow back to a healthy state.
151.hindi_meaning: पुनर्जनन क्षमता वाला (स्वयं को फिर से ठीक करने या पुनर्जीवित करने की क्षमता।)
151.example: The forest has a natural regenerative capacity if left undisturbed.

151.english_meaning: The maximum population size or resource load that an environment can sustainably support.
151.hindi_meaning: वहन क्षमता (पर्यावरण द्वारा बिना किसी नुकसान के झेली जा सकने वाली अधिकतम सीमा।)
151.example: Overpopulation can easily exceed the carrying capacity of the earth.

151.english_meaning: The reduction in the number, quantity, or value of something, especially natural resources.
151.hindi_meaning: रिक्तीकरण या भारी कमी (संसाधनों का तेजी से खत्म होना।)
151.example: Rapid industrialization has led to the depletion of fossil fuels.

151.english_meaning: Electrical power produced from heat, usually generated by burning coal, oil, or natural gas.
151.hindi_meaning: तापीय ऊर्जा (कोयला या गैस जलाकर बनाई जाने वाली बिजली।)
151.example: Thermal power plants release large amounts of carbon dioxide into the air.

151.english_meaning: To overwhelm with water; to flood or submerge an area.
151.example: Large hydroelectric projects inundate vast forest areas and displace local communities.

151.english_meaning: The area of land from which rainfall flows into a river, lake, or reservoir.
151.hindi_meaning: जलग्रहण क्षेत्र (वह क्षेत्र जहाँ से बारिश का पानी बहकर किसी नदी या बांध में इकट्ठा होता है।)
151.example: Protecting the catchment area helps maintain a steady flow of water in the river.

151.english_meaning: Alternative energy sources that are renewable and environment-friendly, such as solar and wind energy.
151.hindi_meaning: गैर-पारंपरिक (ऊर्जा के ऐसे स्रोत जो नवीकरणीय और पर्यावरण के अनुकूल होते हैं।)
151.example: The government is promoting the use of non-conventional sources of energy like solar power.

151.english_meaning: The production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation into the atmosphere.
151.hindi_meaning: उत्सर्जन (गैसों या धुएं का वायुमंडल में छोड़ा जाना।)
151.example: Electric vehicles help reduce carbon emissions in cities.

152.english_meaning: Harmful or unfavorable; having a negative effect.
152.example: Deforestation has adverse implications for the environment.

152.english_meaning: The effects or consequences that are likely to follow from a certain action or condition.
152.example: Using wood as fuel has serious adverse implications for green cover.

152.english_meaning: The clearing or thinning of forests by humans on a large scale.
152.example: Cutting down trees for firewood leads to rapid deforestation.

152.english_meaning: Supported financially by the government to keep the price low for consumers.
152.hindi_meaning: अनुदानित (जिसकी कीमत सरकार द्वारा कम की गई हो)
152.example: The government is providing subsidised LPG to rural households.

152.english_meaning: Turned into a liquid, typically by cooling or compressing a gas.
152.example: LPG stands for Liquefied Petroleum Gas.

152.english_meaning: A semi-liquid mixture of water and insoluble matter, such as manure or clay.
152.hindi_meaning: गाढ़ा घोल या कीचड़ जैसा मिश्रण (गोबर और पानी का मिश्रण)
152.example: The leftover slurry from a gobar gas plant is a very good organic fertiliser.

152.english_meaning: A substance used to improve the quality or condition of something, such as soil.
152.hindi_meaning: सुधारने वाला पदार्थ (मिट्टी की गुणवत्ता बढ़ाने वाला)
152.example: Organic manure acts as a great soil conditioner.

152.english_meaning: Flattened or made smaller by pressure; packed tightly into a smaller space.
152.example: CNG stands for Compressed Natural Gas.

152.english_meaning: In a way that is sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; noticeably.
152.hindi_meaning: पर्याप्त रूप से या काफी हद तक
152.example: The use of CNG has significantly lowered air pollution in Delhi.

152.english_meaning: Taken in or accepted, such as covering an initial financial cost through later benefits.
152.hindi_meaning: समाहित या वहन करना (खर्च आदि का)
152.example: Although the initial cost of wind mills is high, the benefits get easily absorbed.

152.english_meaning: Available as another possibility or choice.
152.example: The city implemented the odd-even scheme on alternative days.

152.english_meaning: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources.
152.hindi_meaning: सतत या संपोषणीय (जो पर्यावरण को नुकसान पहुंचाए बिना जारी रह सके)
152.example: We must adopt sustainable development practices to protect our planet.

153.english_meaning: Economic development that is conducted without depletion of natural resources.
153.hindi_meaning: सतत विकास (ऐसा विकास जो पर्यावरण को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों की जरूरतों से समझौता किए बिना किया जाए।)
153.example: Sustainable development ensures that our natural resources last for future generations.

153.english_meaning: Relating to the conversion of light into electricity, typically using semiconducting materials.
153.hindi_meaning: फोटोवोल्टिक (प्रकाश को सीधे बिजली में बदलने से संबंधित तकनीक या सेल।)
153.example: Photovoltaic cells convert sunlight directly into electrical energy.

153.english_meaning: Provided or equipped with a quality, asset, or talent naturally.
153.hindi_meaning: प्राकृतिक रूप से संपन्न (किसी गुण या संसाधन से युक्त होना।)
153.example: India is naturally endowed with abundant solar energy and sunshine.

153.english_meaning: The process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water.
153.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश संश्लेषण (वह प्रक्रिया जिससे पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश की मदद से अपना भोजन बनाते हैं।)
153.example: Plants use solar energy to perform photosynthesis and grow.

153.english_meaning: Lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time; persisting year round.
153.hindi_meaning: बारहमासी / सदाबहिर (जो साल भर लगातार बना रहे, जैसे कि बारहमासी नदियाँ या झरने।)
153.example: A large percentage of streams in the mountainous regions are perennial.

153.english_meaning: A machine for producing continuous power in which a wheel or rotor is made to revolve by a fast-moving flow of water, steam, gas, or air.
153.hindi_meaning: टर्बाइन (एक मशीन जिसका पहिया पानी या हवा के तेज प्रवाह से घूमकर ऊर्जा पैदा करता है।)
153.example: Mini-hydel plants use the energy of streams to move small turbines.

153.english_meaning: The action or process of transmitting something or the state of being transmitted, especially electricity over long distances.
153.hindi_meaning: संचरण / प्रेषण (बिजली या संकेतों को दूर-दूर तक लाइनों के माध्यम से भेजना।)
153.example: Mini-hydel plants help avoid large-scale transmission loss of electricity.

153.english_meaning: Valued objects and qualities such as cultural traditions, unspoiled historic countryside, and buildings that have been passed down from previous generations.
153.hindi_meaning: विरासत (पुरखों से प्राप्त सांस्कृतिक परंपराएँ, ज्ञान या ऐतिहासिक धरोहर।)
153.example: Drifting away from traditional systems has caused damage to our rural heritage.

153.english_meaning: A fierce or destructive attack, or a large-scale influx or overwhelming presence of something.
153.hindi_meaning: अचानक हमला / भारी प्रभाव (किसी चीज़ का बहुत तेजी से और भारी मात्रा में आगमन या प्रभाव।)
153.example: With the sudden onslaught of western medical systems, traditional practices were ignored.

153.english_meaning: (Of a disease or problem) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.
153.hindi_meaning: दीर्घकालिक / पुराना (ऐसी बीमारी या समस्या जो बहुत लंबे समय से चली आ रही हो।)
153.example: Traditional healthcare systems are in great demand again for treating chronic health problems.

153.english_meaning: Made from or using herbs, especially medicinal ones.
153.hindi_meaning: जड़ी-बूटी से बना हुआ / हर्बल (पौधों और औषधीय जड़ियों से तैयार उत्पाद।)
153.example: Nowadays every cosmetic product is herbal in composition and free from harsh chemicals.

153.english_meaning: The biological decomposition of organic waste under controlled conditions to form natural manure.
153.hindi_meaning: जैव-खाद निर्माण (जैविक कचरे को सड़ाकर प्राकृतिक खाद बनाने की प्रक्रिया।)
153.example: Biocomposting helps restore soil fertility without using harmful chemical fertilizers.

154.english_meaning: The process of making something impure, polluted, or poisonous by adding harmful substances.
154.example: Chemical contamination of water bodies poses a serious threat to public health.

154.english_meaning: A decayed mixture of organic matter such as leaves and manure used to improve soil structure and fertilize plants.
154.example: Farmers are using compost made from organic wastes to enrich the soil naturally.

154.english_meaning: A product or natural substance added to soil to improve its physical qualities, such as fertility and water retention.
154.hindi_meaning: मिट्टी की उर्वरता और बनावट सुधारने वाला पदार्थ
154.example: Animal dung acts as an important fertiliser and soil conditioner in traditional farming.

154.english_meaning: The local government organizations or bodies responsible for administering public services and municipal affairs.
154.example: Civic authorities benefit when citizens reduce waste generation at the household level.

154.english_meaning: The arrival or notable beginning of a significant person, thing, or event.
154.example: With the advent of the green revolution, the use of chemical pesticides increased rapidly.

154.english_meaning: A state or period of uncontrolled excitement, wild activity, or agitation.
154.example: The entire agricultural sector entered into a frenzy to maximize crop yields.

154.english_meaning: Obtained in a pure state by separating it from other substances.
154.example: Several pest-controlling chemicals have been isolated from neem trees.

154.english_meaning: Following continuously; in unbroken or logical sequence.
154.example: Growing different crops in consecutive years helps maintain soil health.

154.english_meaning: Wild animals or insects which are perceived as harmful to crops, food, or livestock, and carry disease.
154.example: Owls and peacocks help control agricultural pests and vermin naturally.

154.english_meaning: A fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions about a subject.
154.hindi_meaning: दृष्टिकोण या अवधारणा में बुनियादी बदलाव
154.example: Sustainable development represents a paradigm shift in modern economic thinking.

154.english_meaning: Attachment or commitment to a rule, principle, or path.
154.example: Strict adherence to sustainable practices ensures lasting welfare for all.

154.english_meaning: Accepting standards that are lower than is desirable; harming or weakening something.
154.example: We must meet present needs without compromising the ability of future generations.

155.english_meaning: The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates, including all living and non-living elements.
155.hindi_meaning: पर्यावरण - वह परिवेश या परिस्थितियाँ जिसमें सभी जीव-जंतु और पौधे निवास करते हैं, जिसमें जैविक और अजैविक दोनों घटक शामिल हैं।
155.example: Protecting our environment is essential for the survival of future generations.

155.english_meaning: Development that meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
155.hindi_meaning: सतत विकास - ऐसा विकास जो भविष्य की पीढ़ियों की आवश्यकताओं को समझौता किए बिना वर्तमान पीढ़ी की जरूरतों को पूरा करता है।
155.example: Governments worldwide are promoting sustainable development to conserve natural resources.

155.english_meaning: The action of taking out something, especially using effort or force, such as removing natural resources from the earth.
155.hindi_meaning: निष्कर्षण - पृथ्वी या प्राकृतिक स्रोतों से किसी चीज़ को बाहर निकालना या खोदकर निकालना (जैसे खनिज या तेल)।
155.example: The rapid extraction of minerals has depleted underground reserves.

155.english_meaning: The process of growing, renewing, or being restored to a new and better condition, especially natural resources.
155.hindi_meaning: पुनरुत्थान / पुनरुत्पादन - प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का दोबारा से बनना या विकसित होना ताकि उनकी कमी पूरी हो सके।
155.example: Trees have the capacity for natural regeneration if they are given enough time.

155.english_meaning: To absorb and integrate information, ideas, or in an environmental context, to absorb and neutralize wastes naturally.
155.hindi_meaning: आत्मसात करना / सोखना - पर्यावरण के संदर्भ में कचरे या प्रदूषण को स्वाभाविक रूप से समाहित और निष्प्रभावी करना।
155.example: Oceans and forests assimilate a large amount of carbon dioxide every year.

155.english_meaning: The variety of plant and animal life in the world or in a particular habitat, a high level of which is usually important.
155.hindi_meaning: जैविक विविधता / जैव विविधता - किसी विशिष्ट क्षेत्र या पूरी दुनिया में पाए जाने वाले विभिन्न प्रकार के पेड़-पौधों और जीव-जंतुओं की विविधता।
155.example: Deforestation poses a major threat to the rich biodiversity of tropical rainforests.

155.english_meaning: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty; providing visual or emotional pleasure.
155.hindi_meaning: सौंदर्यपरक - सुंदरता से संबंधित या जो देखने में सुंदर और मन को सुकून देने वाला हो।
155.example: Parks and green spaces add great aesthetic value to urban areas.

155.english_meaning: Having a great deal of money; wealthy and characterized by high consumption levels.
155.hindi_meaning: समृद्ध / धनवान - अत्यधिक धनवान होना या उच्च उपभोग स्तर वाला जीवन बिताना।
155.example: Affluent lifestyles often lead to higher energy consumption and waste generation.

155.english_meaning: The process of the quality of something, especially the environment or land, being damaged or lowered.
155.hindi_meaning: निम्नीकरण / अवनति - किसी चीज़ की गुणवत्ता में गिरावट आना, विशेषकर भूमि या पर्यावरण का क्षय होना।
155.example: Soil degradation is caused by excessive use of chemical fertilizers and overgrazing.

155.english_meaning: The preservation, protection, or restoration of the natural environment, natural ecosystems, vegetation, and wildlife.
155.hindi_meaning: संरक्षण - प्राकृतिक संसाधनों, वन्यजीवों और पर्यावरण की रक्षा करना और उन्हें नष्ट होने से बचाना।
155.example: Water conservation is crucial in regions facing severe droughts.

155.english_meaning: Having limits or bounds; existing in limited quantity.
155.hindi_meaning: सीमित - जिसकी कोई सीमा हो या जो सीमित मात्रा में उपलब्ध हो (अनंत नहीं)।
155.example: Fossil fuels are finite resources and will eventually run out.

155.english_meaning: The action of forcing something, such as a rule, tax, or burden, to be accepted or put in place.
155.hindi_meaning: थोप देना / अधारोपण - किसी नियम, कर या बोझ को जबरन किसी पर लागू करना या थोपना।
155.example: The imposition of heavy environmental risks on future generations is unfair.

156.english_meaning: The action or state of making a resource or place impure or polluted by adding poisonous or dirty substances.
156.hindi_meaning: संदूषण (पानी, हवा आदि का गंदा या विषैला होना)
156.example: Industrial waste is a major cause of water contamination in rivers.

156.english_meaning: Having a great deal of money; wealthy and enjoying a high standard of living.
156.example: Affluent consumption standards often lead to higher generation of waste.

156.english_meaning: The development of industries in a country or region on a wide scale.
156.example: Rapid industrialisation has brought economic growth but also environmental challenges.

156.english_meaning: The process of making an area more urban, typically through the increasing population of people living in towns and cities.
156.example: Urbanisation puts immense pressure on natural resources and civic infrastructure.

156.english_meaning: The illegal hunting or capturing of wild animals, usually for commercial gain.
156.example: Strict laws are required to prevent the poaching of endangered species.

156.english_meaning: The condition or process of degrading or being deteriorated, especially of land or environment.
156.hindi_meaning: निम्नीकरण या अवनति (भूमि या पर्यावरण की गुणवत्ता का गिरना)
156.example: Deforestation and chemical fertilizers contribute to land degradation.

156.english_meaning: The loss of potential gain from other alternatives when one alternative is chosen.
156.hindi_meaning: अवसर लागत (किसी विकल्प को चुनने पर छोड़े गए सर्वश्रेष्ठ विकल्प का मूल्य)
156.example: The opportunity costs of environmental damages include health hazards and loss of clean water.

156.english_meaning: Economic development that is conducted without depletion of natural resources, meeting the needs of the present without compromising future generations.
156.hindi_meaning: सतत विकास (भविष्य की पीढ़ियों की जरूरतों से समझौता किए बिना वर्तमान की आवश्यकताएं पूरी करना)
156.example: Sustainable development ensures long-term ecological balance and economic growth.

156.english_meaning: A fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen, especially one whose cause or explanation is in question.
156.example: Global warming is not a temporary phenomenon; it is a long-term crisis.

156.english_meaning: A division or contrast between two things that are or are represented as being opposed or entirely different.
156.example: India faces a dichotomy of environmental problems caused by both poverty and affluence.

156.english_meaning: The concept of fairness or justice between generations, particularly regarding the use of environmental resources.
156.hindi_meaning: अंतर-पीढ़ीगत समता (वर्तमान और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के बीच संसाधनों का न्यायसंगत उपयोग)
156.example: Intergenerational equity is a core principle of sustainable development.

156.english_meaning: The reduction in the number or quantity of something, such as natural resources.
156.hindi_meaning: रिक्तीकरण या ह्रास (संसाधनों का तेजी से घटना या समाप्त होना)
156.example: Excessive extraction of groundwater leads to the depletion of water tables.

157.english_meaning: The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
157.hindi_meaning: पर्यावरण या परिवेश जिसमें जीव-जंतु और पौधे निवास करते हैं।
157.example: Protecting our environment is essential for future generations.

157.english_meaning: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources.
157.hindi_meaning: संपोषणीय या टिकाऊ, जो प्राकृतिक संसाधनों को बिना नष्ट किए लंबे समय तक चल सके।
157.example: Sustainable development ensures that resources are conserved for the future.

157.english_meaning: The process of developing or being developed, often economically or socially.
157.example: Economic development should not come at the cost of nature.

157.english_meaning: The gradual destruction or wearing away of land surfaces by wind, water, or other natural agents.
157.hindi_meaning: मृदा अपरदन या कटाव, जिसमें मिट्टी की उपजाऊ परतें बह जाती हैं।
157.example: Deforestation is a major cause of soil erosion in hilly regions.

157.english_meaning: A sudden and rapid increase in the number or amount of something.
157.example: Population explosion puts immense pressure on natural resources.

157.english_meaning: A time of intense difficulty, trouble, or danger.
157.hindi_meaning: संकट या गंभीर समस्या की स्थिति।
157.example: Air pollution has led to an environmental crisis in major cities.

157.english_meaning: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
157.hindi_meaning: कार्यकर्ता जो किसी सामाजिक या राजनीतिक बदलाव के लिए अभियान चलाता है।
157.example: The environmental activist protested against the cutting of trees.

157.english_meaning: A person who owns or helps manage an industrial enterprise.

170.example: Without a good harvest, the economic indicators showed stagnation.

170.english_meaning: The difference in total value between payments into and out of a country over a period.
170.example: India had to borrow from the IMF to set right its balance of payments crisis.

170.english_meaning: The parts, components, or elements that combine to make something whole.
170.example: The GDP and its various sectoral constituents were analyzed by economists.

170.english_meaning: A thing, especially a trend or fact, that indicates the state or level of something.
170.hindi_meaning: सूचक (आर्थिक या सामाजिक स्थिति बताने वाले)
170.example: Several economic indicators showed negative trends during poor harvest years.

171.english_meaning: Estimated by comparison; relative or measured by comparing with other things.
171.example: The textbook presents a comparative study of the development experiences of India and its neighbours.

171.english_meaning: The process of developing or being developed, especially economically and socially.
171.example: Economic development requires careful planning and efficient utilization of human resources.

171.english_meaning: A value or measure that provides information about the state or condition of something.
171.example: Human development indicators include metrics like health, education, and standard of living.

171.english_meaning: A way of regarding, understanding, or interpreting something; a mental impression.
171.example: There is a general perception that foreign goods are flooding the domestic market.

171.english_meaning: The export by a country or company of a product at a price that is lower in the foreign market than the price charged in the domestic market.
171.hindi_meaning: डंपिंग (लागत से कम कीमत पर माल बेचना)
171.example: The sudden dumping of cheap imported goods can severely harm domestic manufacturing sectors.

171.english_meaning: The effects or consequences that are likely to follow from a choice, action, or situation.
171.example: Trade agreements have long-term economic implications for developing nations.

171.english_meaning: The production of goods on a large scale using machinery.
171.example: The government is launching schemes to boost the domestic manufacturing sector.

171.english_meaning: Goods or services produced in one country and sold to buyers in another country.
171.example: India's exports to neighboring countries have grown steadily over the last decade.

171.english_meaning: Commodities, goods, or services brought from a foreign country into a domestic country for sale.
171.example: High imports of electronic items can affect the country's balance of trade.

171.english_meaning: Conducted or carried out business, trade, or an exchange.
171.example: Various goods and services are transacted daily through international trade channels.

171.english_meaning: Consisting of two or more parts, elements, or in this context, calculated over multiple periods on accumulated values.
171.example: The table shows the compound rate of growth for exports and imports.

171.english_meaning: Likely to happen or to be true; realistic or expected.
171.example: Students were asked to discuss the probable reasons for the changing trade trends.

172.english_meaning: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources or financial stability.
172.hindi_meaning: धारणीय / सतत / जो लंबे समय तक टिक सके
172.example: The country needs sustainable export growth to strengthen its foreign exchange reserves.

172.english_meaning: Money sent by workers working abroad to their family members back home.
172.hindi_meaning: विप्रेषण / विदेश से भेजा गया धन
172.example: Pakistan's economy relied heavily on remittances sent by workers in the Middle East.

172.english_meaning: Liable to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse.
172.example: The agricultural sector suffered due to volatile weather conditions and fluctuating market prices.

172.english_meaning: Relating to the branch of economics concerned with large-scale or general economic factors.
172.example: Several macroeconomic indicators began to show stable and positive trends in recent years.

172.english_meaning: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.
172.example: India has taken many initiatives to develop its rural and urban infrastructure.

172.english_meaning: The state of being unstable; lack of stability or firmness.
172.example: Political instability can severely hinder a nation's economic growth and development.

172.english_meaning: The action of making suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe.
172.example: China succeeded in raising its growth rate alongside the alleviation of widespread poverty.

172.english_meaning: Transfer (a business, industry, or service) from public to private ownership or control.
172.example: India and Pakistan are attempting to privatise several loss-making public sector enterprises.

172.english_meaning: A system of parts working together in a machine or a process to achieve a particular result.
172.example: China used the market mechanism to create additional social and economic opportunities.

172.english_meaning: The action or process of intervening, especially to improve or help a situation.
172.example: Government intervention in providing social infrastructure brought about positive results in health and education.

172.english_meaning: The state or quality of being dedicated to a cause, activity, or policy.
172.example: China adopted the market system without losing its political commitment to socialism.

172.english_meaning: A sign or piece of information that shows something is the condition or state of something.
172.example: Human development indicators in China improved significantly prior to economic reforms.

173.english_meaning: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.
173.hindi_meaning: वैश्वीकरण (वह प्रक्रिया जिसके द्वारा दुनिया भर के देश आर्थिक और सांस्कृतिक रूप से आपस में जुड़ते हैं)
173.example: With the unfolding of the globalisation process, developing countries face competition from developed nations.

173.english_meaning: Natural features or qualities possessed by a person or a country.
173.example: India, Pakistan and China have similar physical endowments but totally different political systems.

173.english_meaning: A value or measure that provides information about the state or condition of something.
173.hindi_meaning: सूचक या संकेतक (किसी स्थिति को मापने के आंकड़े)
173.example: Till the early 1980s, the developmental indicators of all the three countries were similar.

173.english_meaning: Relating to a particular sector or sectors, especially of a country's economy.
173.hindi_meaning: क्षेत्रीय (आर्थिक क्षेत्रों जैसे कृषि, उद्योग आदि से संबंधित)
173.example: Sectoral contribution towards national income was similar in the early decades.

173.english_meaning: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of a complex whole.
173.example: China introduced structural reforms on its own initiative in 1978.

173.english_meaning: The power or opportunity to act or take charge before others do.
173.hindi_meaning: पहल (स्वयं आगे बढ़कर कोई काम करना)
173.example: China introduced structural reforms on its own initiative while they were forced upon India.

173.english_meaning: Stop or slow down (a process, or the development of something).
173.hindi_meaning: रोक देना या गति धीमी कर देना
173.example: The one-child norm has arrested the population growth in China.

173.english_meaning: The people engaged in or available for work, either in a country or a particular company or industry.
173.example: Majority of the workforce in all the countries depends on agriculture.

173.english_meaning: Following traditional forms or established rules and patterns.
173.example: China has followed the classical development pattern of gradual shift from agriculture to manufacturing.

173.english_meaning: Regard something as being caused by (someone or something).
173.example: These improvements were attributed not to the reform process but to prior strategies.

173.english_meaning: Evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of something.
173.example: While assessing the developmental indicators, one also has to consider the liberty indicators.

173.english_meaning: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority.
173.example: While assessing the developmental indicators, one also has to consider the liberty indicators.

174.english_meaning: Relating to or characteristic of a particular region or country.
174.example: Regional economic groupings help countries cooperate for mutual growth.

174.english_meaning: Existing or occurring inside a particular country; not foreign.
174.example: Countries are trying to strengthen their own domestic economies through various policies.

174.english_meaning: A careful plan or method for achieving a particular goal over a long period.
174.example: India and Pakistan followed similar developmental strategies for their economies.

174.english_meaning: Caused a process or action to begin.
174.example: China initiated the Great Leap Forward campaign in 1958.

174.english_meaning: To make something clear; to explain.
174.example: Do you agree with China's industrial growth reforms? Elucidate.

174.english_meaning: The effect or consequence that an action or decision will have.
174.example: What is the important implication of the 'one child norm' in China?

174.english_meaning: Relating to the dynamic structure of populations.
174.example: Mention the salient demographic indicators of China, Pakistan, and India.

174.english_meaning: A sign or piece of information that shows something exists or is true.
174.example: Gross Domestic Product and human development are key economic indicators.

174.english_meaning: Relating to a specific sector or branch of an economy.
174.example: Let us compare India and China's sectoral contribution towards GVA/GDP.

174.english_meaning: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions.
174.example: Define the liberty indicator and give some examples of it.

174.english_meaning: To form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess.
174.example: Evaluate the various factors that led to rapid economic development in China.

174.english_meaning: The ability to produce offspring; in demographics, the natural capability to bear children.
174.example: A low fertility rate is one of the demographic features of China.

175.example: The teacher asked us to do a comparative study of two countries.

175.english_meaning: The appearance of something again after it has been forgotten or disappeared for a while.
175.example: The re-emergence of poverty in the region worried the economists.
We discussed the salient features of the economic policy.

175.english_meaning: A thing, especially a trend or fact, that indicates the state or level of something.
175.example: Life expectancy is an important human development indicator.
The new five-year plan commenced in April.

175.english_meaning: A part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole.
175.example: A large proportion of the population works in the agricultural sector.

175.english_meaning: The improvement or amendment of what is wrong, corrupt, or unsatisfactory.
175.example: Economic reforms were introduced to open up the market.

175.english_meaning: A person or thing that corresponds to or has the same function as another in a different place or situation.
175.example: Indian electronic goods are competing well with their foreign counterparts.

175.english_meaning: Relating to the running of a home or to a particular country; internal.
175.example: Cheap imports can sometimes harm domestic producers.

175.english_meaning: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of a complex whole.
175.example: The economy is undergoing major structural changes.

175.english_meaning: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate.
175.example: We discussed the relevance of this theory in modern times.

175.english_meaning: The making of articles on a large scale using machinery.
175.example: The manufacturing sector plays a crucial role in China's growth.

176.english_meaning: Relating to the economics or economy of a country, region, or society.
176.example: The country is facing major economic challenges and high inflation.

176.english_meaning: The process of developing or being developed, especially economically or socially.
176.example: Sustainable development ensures progress without harming the environment.

176.english_meaning: A set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.
176.example: Education provides equal opportunity for all children to succeed.

176.english_meaning: An extraordinary and welcome event that is not explicable by natural or scientific laws.
176.example: Rapid industrial growth is often described as an economic miracle.

176.english_meaning: A fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen, especially one whose cause is in question.
176.example: Global warming is a complex environmental phenomenon.

176.english_meaning: The governing body of a nation, state, or community.
176.example: The government announced a new policy to support farmers.

176.english_meaning: A government department headed by a minister.
176.example: The Ministry of Finance released the annual economic survey.

176.english_meaning: A planned series of future events or items to be done or achieved.
176.example: The United Nations Development Programme works globally to eradicate poverty.

176.english_meaning: A thing, especially a trend or fact, that indicates the state or level of something.
176.example: GDP and inflation are key economic indicators of a nation's health.

176.english_meaning: Work, especially hard physical work, or the workforce as a whole.
176.example: Labour market reforms are necessary to boost employment rates.

176.english_meaning: An official group of people entrusted with a particular duty or power.
176.example: The planning commission oversees national resource allocation.

176.english_meaning: The use of a source of information in order to ascertain something or provide credit.
176.example: Academic research papers must include proper citations and references.
